criteria.requirement: Implement werkzeug.conditional_json.cacheable_json(value,request,*,offers=("application/json",),max_age=0) using completed negotiated_json.json_response. Permit GET/HEAD only, compute strong ETag from actual selected UTF8 representation bytes, set public/max-age and reuse real Response.apply_conditions for If-None-Match/If-Match ordering and native 304/412 behavior. Retain Vary Accept and normal HEAD wire semantics. Changed representation must change ETag, matching GET/HEAD response has no wire body. Validate nonnegative integer age, preserve request and avoid reimplementing ETag comparison with substrings.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
